Step 1: 1106 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but not by 100 unless divisible by 400; 1106 mod 4 = 2, so not leap).  
Step 2: Subtract 327 days from 1106-11-25.  
Step 3: Go back 25 days to 1106-10-31. Remaining: 327 - 25 = 302 days.  
Step 4: Subtract month-by-month from Oct 31:  
Oct: 0 days left (already at Oct 31),  
Sep 30 → 302 - 30 = 272,  
Aug 31 → 272 - 31 = 241,  
Jul 31 → 241 - 31 = 210,  
Jun 30 → 210 - 30 = 180,  
May 31 → 180 - 31 = 149,  
Apr 30 → 149 - 30 = 119,  
Mar 31 → 119 - 31 = 88,  
Feb 28 → 88 - 28 = 60,  
Jan 31 → 60 - 31 = 29.  
Step 5: 29 days before Jan 1, 1106 is 1105-12-03 (since Dec 31 → 1 day back, Dec 30 → 2 days back, …, Dec 3 → 29 days back).  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1105-12-03
